title: Radio
description: Internet radio through the mirror's speakers: Sveriges Radio and stations worldwide, with what's on now.

stations.title: Stations
stations.description: The stations, in the order a double press steps through them.

station.title: Station
station.description: Its name, such as Sveriges Radio P4 Göteborg or Mix Megapol, looked up in Radio Browser; or the stream's address (https://…).

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: How loud, as it sounds (0-100). The Settings tab's volume sets the whole mirror's.

output.title: Speakers
output.description: Where the sound goes. The screen only if it has speakers: one without them stays silent.

autoplay.title: Play When Shown
autoplay.description: Start playing when the mirror starts. It stops while the screen is off or the module is hidden (its schedule, privacy mode) and plays again after.

button.title: Button
button.description: The mirror's button that controls the radio: one press plays or stops, two go to the next station. Set that button's own actions to nothing in the Hardware tab.

show_header.title: Show Header
show_header.description: Show or hide the module's title.

token.title: Token
token.description: Optional: lets a phone shortcut start, stop or send a stream to the radio (see its README). Empty: nobody can.
